subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 452 (EXT.F(II)-14). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject. The title names EXP-DY (expansion dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: TRS (transition). From TRS: COS-D (cosmic dictates), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From COS-D: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From CULT-SOLD: PRI-INFO (principle information) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TM: AFL (affinity alignment), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
